minor.issue: Public HTTP response strips internal fields (id, scopes, kind_meta). Scope/id enforcement is only verifiable in-process via backend/tests/test_iter273_inspection_qaqc_coaching.py — not via the public API contract. Not a regression vs prior iters; flagged for awareness.

critical_code_review_comments: iter273 implementation faithfully clones iter270 meeting pattern: 1 HelpTipBlock import + N mounts per page, no new component, no new endpoint, no new schema — strict scope honored.
NewInspection.jsx (5 mounts) and NewQaqcInspection.jsx (6 mounts) wire to existing /api/guidance/tips registry via formKey props; no per-mount data fetch coupling.

Pytest test_iter273_inspection_qaqc_coaching.py only resolves the 'guidance' package when pytest is invoked with cwd=/app/backend. Recommend either adding /app/backend to sys.path inside the test file or wiring a /app/conftest.py — would let CI run pytest from repo root without 6 spurious ModuleNotFoundError failures. Not a code bug, but a developer-experience snag.
